purpose: Descriptive, after v7's record (post hoc; not part of v7's deposited conditions), run once on the work PC on the production captures: (1) which injected presses the page marked as key repeats, counted by kind, previous kind, whether the planned key equals the previous planned key, the planned and recorded gap before it, and the position in the session; (2) the page-layer readings of v7 again with those presses kept as counted presses (the human side H0 against H1_idle, the replay error of H1_idle, and every machine series' plan against record), beside v7's readings that drop them; (3) for M2_8B and M2_14B, how the sessions whose D1 judgment flips from 'machine' (plan) to 'human' (page) differ from those that keep it, on the plan's zero gaps, delta on plan, hook and page, the presses the page dropped, and the share of short recorded gaps. Nothing here changes v7's readings; it is reported in the paper's supplement as post hoc.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-13 after v7's record (record.json 53c03bf7..., analysis commit 07f388a) and after attack-me round 1 of paper B's manuscript (the researcher's decisions 4 and 6 of .steering/20261113-v7-production-v4-returns). Seen before writing: v7's record (counts and summaries only; the page dropped as repeats H1_idle 42, H1_load 42, H1_rep 7, M0 46, M1_8B 46, M1_14B 50, M3a 46, M3b 44, M2_8B 15, M2_14B 21 presses, none on the hook; D1/page/M2_8B read 'responds' with b = 0, c = 11 on 25 pairs). No capture has been read for this version. The captures stay on the work PC. Code: works/prototype_v7q.py, committed with this file; it imports v7's analysis code at a6fa5ca unchanged.

base.reads: prototype_v7_run.load_all (the runlogs and captures as analysed), the page.ndjson lines again for the repeat flag, prototype_v7_run.draw_persons and train (the same persons, training and seeds), Scorer.score, judgments, recorded, plan_gaps, replay_error_series, prototype_v7.headline, judged_pairs and machine_path_reading

repeats_census: On the page layer of every captured item: the key lines of a counted kind, in the box and not composing, in capture order, with their repeat flag. For each flagged line: its kind; the kind of the previous such line; when the item's page lines (flagged included) hold as many presses as its plan with the same kinds, whether the planned key equals the previous planned key (true/false only, never the key) and the planned gap before it; the recorded page gap before it; its position in the session in tenths. Counted per series; gaps in bins [0, 1), [1, 5), [5, 20), [20, 50), [50, 150), [150, inf) ms. Also per series the number of items with at least one flag and the hook's flagged downs of injected presses.
repeats_kept: The page layer read with flagged presses kept as counted presses (otherwise v7's reading unchanged: stable sort, equal times dropped). Reported: the human side H0 against H1_idle per detector (b, c, n and v7's headline reading), H1_idle's page replay error (replay_error_series: matched captures, drops, jitter and drift), and for each machine series and detector the plan against the record (b, c, n, the plan's and record's 'machine' counts, and the reading of machine_path_reading on complete pairs with each session its own cluster, key [20261113, 7, 2, detector index, series index] in v7's orders). Missing pairs are counted, not placed back.
m2_sessions: For M2_8B and M2_14B, each captured session falls in one group: 'plan not judged' (D1 gives the plan no judgment), 'flips' (plan 'machine', page 'human'), 'stays machine' (plan and page 'machine'), 'stays human' (plan 'human'). Per group: the count and, with at least 5 sessions, quantiles (5th to 95th percentiles, as v7's summary) of the plan's share of zero gaps, delta of plan, hook and page (main cleaning), the page's dropped equal times and flagged repeats per session, and the share of recorded gaps below 1 ms on hook and page. Also delta on the page with repeats kept and with equal times kept.
reading: Descriptive only: no prediction, no test, no change of v7's readings. The paper states which property differs between the groups only as a description.
limits: Post hoc, after v7's values. The census cannot see why Chrome sets the flag. M2's groups are small (at most 25 judged plans per model).
record: results/prototype_v7q/record.json: counts and summaries only (no press time, gap list, key, text, LLM output, per-session or per-person value, or identifier). Returned with its SHA-256; the captures are not returned.
